assays.assay_description: Mice freely explore a looming chamber containing a shelter; after 5-min acclimation, three expanding black-disk looming stimuli (0–24 cm in 1 s, repeated 15 times in 15 s) are triggered with >5-min intervals. Measures: freezing time in shelter, escape latency, time in shelter, return time, locomotion. Run across 4-AcO-DMT/S-MDMA/R-MDMA/TBG/IHCH-7086/ketamine/caffeine doses, with PCPA or M100907 pretreatment, β-arrestin 2 KO, IBO lesions, DREADD chemogenetics, caspase ablation, 5-HT2A cKO/re-expression, in both sexes, and at 5 min, 24 h and 7 days post-dose.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were prepared on the day of the experiment and administered intraperitoneally. CNO was injected intraperitoneally 30 min before behavioral tests.

setup_habituation.evidence: The day before the behavioral experiment, mice were transferred to the chamber for habituation for 15 min.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice with a miniature camera were placed into a looming device and moved freely; behaviour recorded with an infrared camera.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the looming chamber during the test.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the looming chamber during the test.

time_to_assay.evidence: all drugs were administered 5 min before the experiment; 'At 24 h or 7 days after 4-AcO-DMT injection, its anti-innate fear effect was no longer detectable (Fig. S4D-I).'

sample_size.evidence: n = 16 mice per group (Fig. 1B); n = 15 mice per group for many mechanistic groups; n = 7 mice per group for the MD IBO experiment (Fig. 7C); n = 8 mice per group (Fig. 7J, K).

outcomes.summary: 4-AcO-DMT reduced looming-induced freezing time in the shelter with a U-shaped dose-response (optimal 0.5 mg/kg) and no effect on escape latency; S-MDMA, R-MDMA, TBG, IHCH-7086, ketamine and caffeine did not reduce freezing (5 mg/kg S-MDMA increased it). The anti-fear effect was blocked by M100907, unaffected by PCPA depletion or β-arrestin 2 KO, required PrL CaMKIIα 5-HT2A receptors and the PrL–MD projection, showed no sex difference, and was absent 24 h and 7 days after dosing.
outcomes.statistics: one-way ANOVA with Dunnett's multiple comparisons versus vehicle group, *P<0.05, ***P<0.001 (Fig. 1B); two-way ANOVA with Tukey's multiple comparisons, *P<0.05, **P<0.01, ***P<0.001, ###P<0.001, ns (Figs. 2D, F, K; 5C-L; 6A-H; 7C-K)
outcomes.evidence: Compared with vehicle group, 4-AcO-DMT reduced the looming-induced freezing time in the shelter, showing a U-shaped dose-response curve (Fig. 1B, videos 1 and 2). The optimal dose of 4-AcO-DMT that attenuated looming-induced freezing was 0.5 mg/kg. ... At 24 h or 7 days after 4-AcO-DMT injection, its anti-innate fear effect was no longer detectable.

judge_notes: All three candidates converged on the same six behavioural assays: HTR, looming test, OFT, visual cliff, place aversion, and EPM. No duplicates or misclassifications needed to be dropped.

Excluded non-behavioural endpoints: fiber photometry GCaMP recording, pupil-size eye-tracking (physiological/imaging readout, not a behavioural task), heart-rate telemetry, EGR1 immunofluorescence, 5-HT ELISA, hormone radioimmunoassay, and anterograde tracing.

Place aversion is kept separate from the looming test: although it uses the same apparatus, no looming stimulus is delivered and a different behavioural construct (unconditioned shelter/place preference) is measured over a 30-min free-exploration session.

All DREADD/chemogenetic, lesion, caspase-ablation, 5-HT2A cKO/re-expression, β-arrestin 2 KO, PCPA and M100907 variants of the looming test were collapsed into one Looming assay entry per the rubric's assay-identity rules.
B1 for the looming assay set to 2 (4-6 measures): freezing time, escape latency, time in shelter, return time, and in-test locomotion are all reported (Figs. 1B, S1A-B, S2H-J).
B2 for HTR scored 1 (Yes): the paper explicitly states HTRs were measured in six 5-min blocks within the 30-min session, i.e. within-session binning (qwen and gemma4 agreed; deepseek4 overridden).
D2 for the looming test scored 1 (15–60 min): 5-min acclimation plus three stimuli separated by >5-min intervals necessarily exceeds 15 min (gemma4's <15 min overridden).
D1/D3/D5 for the looming test reflect the 24-h and 7-day retests reported in Fig. S4D-I (multiple discrete sessions, 2-7 recording days, post-acute follow-up = Yes).
D5 follow-up scored 0 for HTR, OFT, visual cliff, place aversion and EPM — the 24 h / 7 d retests are explicitly only described for the looming freezing measure.
B1 corrections applied where candidates mis-mapped category to points: '1 measure' = 0 points (gemma4 had assigned 1 point); '2-3 measures' = 1 point (gemma4 had assigned 2).
Sex set to 'both' (deepseek4/gemma4): the paper explicitly compared male and female mice in the looming test (Fig. S4A-C), although mechanistic work was male-only.
enrichment_housing = yes based on 'Shelters were placed in animal cages for a week', an explicit home-cage enrichment item.

Dosing list expanded to include all administered comparator compounds (S-MDMA, R-MDMA, TBG, IHCH-7086, ketamine); exact dose arrays for TBG/IHCH-7086 are not given in the main text so arrays left empty.
